gallery.title: Eclipse Clear Skies
gallery.description: Live clear-sky forecaster for the 12 Aug 2026 total solar eclipse over western Iceland: exact per-location totality times computed from NASA's Besselian elements, blended multi-model cloud forecasts at each spot's own mid-eclipse minute, live doppler radar and IR satellite overlays, and a ranked list of the best places to stand — refreshing itself as new model runs land.
